positioning.serviceFamily: AI Apps & Agents as a Service
positioning.summary: Production-ready curated research agent pattern that keeps answer-time web access disabled while an isolated content plane refreshes signed, verified snapshots.

runtime.defaultRuntimeEndpoint: Curated Research Agent / Foundry Responses API

tools.description: Searches only the promoted, signature-verified snapshot. The answering agent has no live web egress.

query.description: Question to answer from the verified approved-source snapshot.

max_results.description: Maximum number of verified snapshot passages to return.

max_snippet_chars.description: Maximum snippet length returned per result.

samplePayload.query: Summarize current approved-source guidance for isolating web search in agentic systems.

governance.dataBoundary: Two independently deployed planes share only a signed snapshot artifact and verification key. The content plane has allowlisted HTTPS egress but no model or agent tools. The answer plane has no web egress and reads only a promoted, signature-verified snapshot.
governance.authModel: Separate managed identities for snapshot builder and curated research agent. Production signing key must live in Key Vault: builder signs; answer plane verifies only.
allowedOutbound: content-plane allowlisted public HTTPS FQDNs only

evidence.name: Option C full offline test suite
Option C architecture and production-readiness review
evidence.summary: README, ARCHITECTURE-GUIDE, AGENTS.md, builder/agent source, and tests document the two-plane architecture: signed live-refresh snapshot builder plus no-egress curated research agent.

promotionRules: Production deployment must keep builder and answer-plane identities separate.
Production signing key must be managed outside source control, preferably in Key Vault.
Builder egress must be restricted to approved HTTPS FQDNs at both app and network layers.
Answer plane must have no live web egress and must fail closed on invalid snapshot signature, hash, version, or missing files.
Timer and queue refresh bindings must run the same build-and-promote pipeline.
